parameters.name: analyzerType
parameters.description:
The type of the dictionary. Valid values:

*   IK: IK dictionary after a standard update
*   IK_HOT: IK dictionary after a rolling update
*   SYNONYMS: synonym dictionary
*   ALIWS: Alibaba Cloud dictionary

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the dictionary file.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch list-dicts --analyzer-type IK --name SYSTEM_MAIN.dic --instance-id es-cn-0ju29ifnc00050000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
